title: Zoning map change for 50-20 108th Street, Queens
summary: This application would change zoning at 50-20 108th Street in Corona, Queens from R6B to R7A and establish a C2-4 commercial overlay. Combined with a related text amendment, it would facilitate two mixed-use buildings totaling about 216,400 square feet with 196 apartments, 51 of them income-restricted. The City Council held a public hearing on June 17, 2026.
